title: How come we can't have dessert?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: We are not having any dessert tonight.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: How come we can't have dessert?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Your tummy is still full of party cake and candy.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: But that was a long time ago!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: The sugar is still in there, bouncing around. It will keep you awake at bedtime.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: How come sugar keeps me awake?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: It makes your body want to jump and play, even in bed.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Okay. Can I have dessert tomorrow, then?

variations: "dessert" 换 "ice cream"；"cake and candy" 换 "birthday cake"。
